title: Healthy baseline
summary: A steady Contoso Care OLTP mix: front-desk patient lookups, provider schedules, billing balances, check-ins, work-queue triage, supply updates, and audit events. Short, indexed statements with no blocking, used as the baseline activity profile and as the before picture for every incident.

intensity.description: Pace: about 1 operation per second per session at 1, about 20 at 10.

notes.T3: Keeps the serverless database awake while it runs; the T3 baseline in activity-profiles.json uses one session at intensity 2.
notes.T4: The PostgreSQL steps (database/postgresql/120-scenario-functions.sql): the same lookups, a work-item touch, and a tagged audit row; the T4 baseline uses one session at intensity 2.

expectedHubSignals.signal: SqlServerPerformanceCountersCommon: Batch Requests/sec and Transactions/sec steady
SqlServerActiveSessions: a few ContosoCare.Demo/healthy-baseline sessions, none blocked
No Database Agent finding for the target
expectedHubSignals.note: Preview; coverage by target is undocumented (ADR 0013).

expectedHubSignals.signal: T4: CPU (cpu_percent) and Connections (active_connections) low and flat
expectedHubSignals.note: Database Hub's PostgreSQL dashboard (Azure Monitor metrics; Hub has no query-level data for PostgreSQL).

expectedSymptoms: Short, indexed queries with no blocking and no lock waits
Stable CPU, memory, and IO; Processes blocked stays at 0
A small, bounded number of audit rows written by the workload (trimmed hourly and removed by reset)
queryLevelEvidence: Query Store: many short queries with low duration and logical reads
demo.scenario_runs and demo.scenario_run_events record the run, its sessions, and its counters
reset: Status changes toggle within their seeded values, so business data stays as seeded; auto-cleanup and reset remove the workload's audit rows.
